title: Zoe footer
description: A deep plum footer opened by a hairline: 'follow us' with social icons on the left, then small link groups (company, address, legal, resources) in columns, and a bottom row with the copyright and a region picker. Groups stack on phones.
notes: the band is the secondary colour; it carries on from zoe-explore
groups flow into three columns after the 'follow us' one; give a group stackWithNext to put the next group under it
name: zoe-footer

props.name: followLabel
props.description: the line above the social icons

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: social links as icons (e.g. lucide icons at size-6)

props.name: region
props.description: the region picker on the right: a label and an optional flag or icon before it
